blurb: Guests can fish for bottom fish, salmon, halibut, tuna, and lingcod on year-round charters with expert crews and gear. Whale watching tours offer close encounters with gray whales, humpbacks, and orcas, with knowledgeable captains narrating. Private charters for weddings and memorials at sea are also available.

quotes.author: Jon
quotes.text: Tad was so great with accommodating our child swap. He made it so easy! The trip was beautiful and the whales behaved nicely so we could get a good glimpse of them! Be sure to go into the gift shop for ginger chews and anti-nausea meds. I look forward to us coming again and even booking a fishing trip!

quotes.author: Nate Kunz
quotes.text: Great experience taking my boys fishing for fist time today. They were great on cloud 9 each time a fish hit the line or that we pulled up a crab trap. Captain Brad and his shipmate were so good with my boys.

quotes.author: merissa standifer
quotes.text: My husband, father in law, and I just did the bottom fishing and crabbing trip. Everything was well organized and the captain and deckhands were awesome! We’ll definitely book with Tradewinds again!

quotes.author: Vikram Gopal
quotes.text: We loved our cruise 🚢 and saw 4 whales 🐳 and 6 seals 🦭 on our trip! Perfect 1 hour tour off Depoe Bay
